source: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)

players.product: Power supply and facility systems for data centers and semiconductor factories: substation equipment (switchboards, molded transformers) and UPS

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): of the JPY 60.0 billion year-on-year increase in power supply and facility systems orders, nearly two-thirds is attributable to Japan and more than one-third to overseas; the majority of these orders are from data center operators (projects developed over years in Japan taking shape, plus overseas customers building data centers in Japan), and orders from semiconductor factories for high-voltage substation equipment were received ahead of schedule
quarterly_data.figure: JPY 60.0 billion year-on-year increase in orders; nearly two-thirds Japan, more than one-third overseas

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): Fuji Electric is projecting data center-related sales of JPY 100.0 billion in the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 and anticipates overseas data center-related sales will increase; it is possible both orders and sales might rise further than anticipated, and the company will keep adjusting forecasts while developing production systems for robust overseas demand
quarterly_data.figure: data center-related sales of JPY 100.0 billion projected for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): to respond to demand the company has been bolstering production capacity at Fuji SMBE Pte Ltd. factories in Malaysia and in Australia (contributing to increased orders from Australia) and has raised switchboard production at Fuji Electric Manufacturing (Thailand) Co., Ltd.; capacity increases were made overseas, such as in Thailand, ahead of Japan, and the Kobe Factory in Japan is anticipated to begin contributing to performance in the fourth quarter

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): second-quarter sales in the power supply and facility systems business are expected to be nearly double those of the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027, with overseas sales projected to grow
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 sales expected nearly double Q1

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): Fuji Electric obtained certification from UL Solutions in July 2026 and has since received data center-related orders in North America, though the volume is still small; North American customers have also asked it to assist with projects in Asia and India, and it anticipates further expansion in the North American market around 2029-2030

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): demand associated with the transition to 800 V direct current power at data centers is almost nonexistent, although one customer has mentioned the possibility of Fuji Electric supporting this transition in the future

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): the company is developing high-value-added UPSs that are more compact and use less energy at low loads, aiming for higher profitability; asked about data center opportunities, it said large-capacity products are the mainstay of its lineup, with a focus on UPSs, energy storage systems and air-conditioning equipment; its lineup will transform with the shift toward SiC devices, and it anticipates demand for small-capacity products for server rack applications and is preparing products for them

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): the second-half forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 was not revised because the company must assess plant and system order trends and the impact of rising material prices and procurement difficulties created by the situation in the Middle East; nevertheless it believes favorable conditions will continue and sees upside potential

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): power generation strength came from highly profitable overseas geothermal power projects; in Japan, hydro power demand has been particularly firm, with long-term projects for delivery between 2030 and 2035 particularly brisk, and proposals responding to customers' nuclear power needs have contributed to orders

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): semiconductor-related sales accounted for roughly 20% of total component sales in the first quarter of the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 (ED&C components, especially breakers, measuring instruments and small-capacity power supplies for production and testing equipment); sales contributions from customizable controllers and small-capacity power supplies for testing equipment are expected to begin in that fiscal year; in China, factory automation components were weak while ED&C components for semiconductor applications grew smoothly
quarterly_data.figure: semiconductor-related sales roughly 20% of total component sales in Q1

quarterly_data.quarter: Fuji Electric results briefing Q&A: Condensed Q&A, Three Months Ended June 30, 2026 (07-30-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (results briefing Q&A): in the Semiconductors segment, industrial semiconductor demand rose for servos, numerically controlled machine tools, inverters and other factory automation motor drives and renewable energy storage systems, while automotive semiconductor demand was as projected; operating profit rose on higher industrial sales and cost reduction such as yield improvements; for the second half, automotive is expected in line with the initial forecast and industrial might be slightly higher than projected
